comparison.objective: Build a three-layer box crib from crossed, overlapping pairs at a load point.
comparison.physical_skill: Repeated structural placement and orthogonal stacking of large members.
comparison.success_condition: Three crossed-pair layers with every corner overlapping; body provides no numeric stability or alignment rubric.
comparison.reason: Structural stacking tests load-bearing arrangement, not coaxial tool placement, contact-driven notch fracture, controlled hammering, or fragment recovery.
